rc NPM package includes malicious coa dependency

Target: rc
Repository: https://github.com/dominictarr/rc
Date: 2021-11-04 to 2021-11-05 (1 day)
Attribution: Compromised Dependency
Component: Library
Language: Javascript
Cause: Malicious Dependency
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: true
Impact Type: Data Exfiltration
User Impact: 10000000
Domain: npmjs.org (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: dependency

Synopsis

The 'rc' configuration loader NPM package was compromised indirectly. Attackers gained control of the 'coa' package (a dependency) and published malicious versions. When 'rc' was updated to use these compromised 'coa' versions, 'rc' itself began distributing password-stealing malware transitively.

Compromised Versions

  • 1.2.9
  • 1.3.9
  • 2.3.9
